integrity: The claim is derived from the printed vector field and does not treat finite simulation as proof of invariant-measure statements.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the polynomial Clapp model with positive circuit parameters and compact invariant support.
The strict threshold-crossing conclusion additionally assumes ergodicity and one-sided support.
Does not prove existence or uniqueness of a particular chaotic or hyperchaotic attractor.
title: Equilibrium-axis barycenter rigidity in the cubic Clapp oscillator
